group: TSIG.apply(Message, int, TSIGRecord, boolean) – functional and edge‑case tests

cases.expected: Message contains exactly one additional record of type TSIG; the record was produced by TSIG.generate with the same parameters; m.tsigState == Message.TSIG_SIGNED
cases.description: Basic happy‑path: no previous TSIG (old == null), no error code, and a normal (non‑full) signature. After apply the message must have a TSIG record in the ADDITIONAL section and the tsigState flag set to SIGNED.

cases.expected: Message contains exactly one additional TSIG record; the generated record incorporates the supplied old TSIG as the previous record; m.tsigState == Message.TSIG_SIGNED
cases.description: Pass a non‑null previous TSIG record (old). The generate method must use this old record when computing the MAC. Verify that the new TSIG is still added and the state flag is updated.

cases.expected: Message contains exactly one additional TSIG record; the record is a full‑signature (covers the whole message); m.tsigState == Message.TSIG_SIGNED
cases.description: Force a full‑signature generation (fullSignature == true). The resulting TSIG record should be a full‑signature; the test only asserts that a TSIG record is added and the state flag is set.

cases.expected: Message contains exactly one additional TSIG record whose error field equals 9; m.tsigState == Message.TSIG_SIGNED
cases.description: Pass a non‑zero DNS error code. The generate method should embed this error in the TSIG record. Verify that the record reflects the supplied error value.
Calling apply with a null Message should raise NPE because the method dereferences the Message to call generate and addRecord.

cases.expected: Message contains exactly one additional TSIG record whose error field equals -1; m.tsigState == Message.TSIG_SIGNED
cases.description: Edge case: negative error code (not a valid DNS RCODE). The method should still forward the value to generate and add the resulting TSIG record.

cases.expected: Message contains exactly one additional TSIG record; the record is generated using the supplied old TSIG and fullSignature==true; m.tsigState == Message.TSIG_SIGNED
cases.description: Combination of a previous TSIG record and full‑signature flag. Ensures that both inputs are correctly passed through generate.

group: TSIG.apply(Message, int, TSIGRecord, boolean) – exception scenarios

cases.description: The supplied old TSIGRecord has a null algorithm name. TSIG.generate will attempt to use the algorithm name to obtain a Mac instance, leading to a NullPointerException before the record can be added.

The old TSIGRecord specifies an algorithm that is not recognised by the JCE provider. When TSIG.generate tries to create a Mac instance, a NoSuchAlgorithmException is thrown and wrapped as an IllegalArgumentException.
The old TSIGRecord contains a null key (the secret). TSIG.generate will attempt to initialise the Mac with a null SecretKey, causing a NullPointerException.
